summary: Fresh re-import smoke test of Laboratorium Product Development (Elastech) from github.com/karismswzet-tech/WEBApp6Astm.git. Verified end-to-end that the imported pod is healthy: 39/39 pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_smoke_import.py covering auth (login sets HttpOnly `elastech_session` cookie, /auth/me 200 with cookie / 401 without, bad password rejected, logout clears cookie), 15 protected list/history/dashboard/trend endpoints returning 401 unauthenticated and 200 authenticated for all 6 modules (K-HTT, DKA, Copper, Rust, HTCBT; DKA-CEC uses /htcbt/* shared routes + /dkacec/* OCR), and 4 reference-scale endpoints. Frontend: landing page loads correctly (title 'Laboratorium Product Development', hero + 'Masuk' button visible), 'Masuk' routes to /login, admin/admin123 logs in and redirects to /khtt (K-HTT dashboard shows seeded data: 9 total, latest KHT-2026-05-30-001, rating 8.7/10). Sidebar navigation verified for all 6 modules — /kht, /copper-strip, /rating-dka, /htcbt, /dka-cec, /rust-preventing — each renders without page errors or crash states. LOGOUT button in sidebar works: redirects to /login and subsequent attempt to visit /khtt bounces back to /login (cookie cleared). No console errors beyond one benign favicon/asset 404.
